prereg.statement: P0c: on COCO images at 128 px, with a predictor whose receptive field (23 px) exceeds the hidden block (8 px) and its neighbours, the normalised residual autocorrelation read AT the receptive field (acf_at_rf) separates THING cells from STUFF cells better than the naive short-lag structuredness statistic
prereg.decision_rule: same thresholds as E0/E0b, applied to the primary statistic: GO iff mean AUC >= 0.65 over >= 3 seeds AND margin over naive >= 0.03 AND mean - std >= 0.6; NO-GO iff mean < 0.6
prereg.precondition: fraction of labelled cells with RAW ell_acf > receptive field must reach 0.05; otherwise the verdict is 'regime empty' (NO-GO by construction), reported apart from a separation failure
prereg.mask: 1 block in 3 hidden (33%), complementary groups, each block hidden exactly once in the diagnostic sweep; chosen at or under the 40% ceiling requested on the grounds that a local predictor needs visible context inside its receptive field to learn anything beyond a blur
prereg.fuse: abort at 20% of the budget if the loss gained < 1% since 10%
prereg.registered: 2026-09-16, before the first run of this script, after E-002
